question:
'Y ① Z' means 'Y is the sister of Z'.

'Y ② Z' means 'Y is the husband of Z'.

'Y ③ Z' means 'Y is the daughter of Z'.

'Y ④ Z' means 'Y is the mother of Z'.

'Y ⑤ Z' means 'Y is the brother of Z'.

In the following expression, select the option that can replace the question mark(?) to establish that 'C is the child of L'.

U ④ L ② G ④ M ① O ? C

2f:T8ba,
<p&g
solution:
Given,

• Y ① Z ⇒ Y is the sister of Z

• Y ② Z ⇒ Y is the husband of Z

• Y ③ Z ⇒ Y is the daughter of Z

• Y ④ Z ⇒ Y is the mother of Z

• Y ⑤ Z ⇒ Y is the brother of Z

Given expression- U ④ L ② G ④ M ① O ? C

• U ④ L ⇒ U is the mother of L

• L ② G ⇒ L is the husband of G

• G ④ M ⇒ G is the mother of M

• M ① O ⇒ M is the sister of O

The given information is depicted in the diagram below-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bdce9ecb46abb4419100d68b2e27d5d1930eeea4e624081e97101410d98bfd6e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bfe4d4d78e7f21704575c4561d635b964607ddb862d2d482c0d9166ebd9acd9.png] 

Thus, O can either be sister or brother of C to establish that C is the child of L.

Hence, '**option 4' **is the correct answer.
